opportunities.title: Nuffield Farming Next-Gen Scholarship

amount.raw: The successful applicants will be awarded a Next-Gen Scholarship worth £6,000, plus a £1,000 financial incentive to part cover replacement labour cost

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Young people aged 18-24, resident in the UK, with a demonstrable interest in the relevant sector (e.g. dairy, regenerative agriculture; 2027 plans dairy and pig scholarships).
opportunities.summary: A fully funded 30-day study tour scholarship for young people aged 18-24 to develop their understanding of the farming industry, build networks and future opportunities. Includes all travel and subsistence, induction in London, stays on farms with Nuffield Scholars, attendance at the Nuffield Conference, and Nuffield Farming Associate membership. Applications for the 2027 cycle open in November 2026.
